explanation: The execution is faulty because qualifying corpus record n06-r06 was silently omitted before the upstream handoff. The top-level corpus includes n06-r06 with demand_score 5, so it qualifies under the demand_score >= 3 rule and should have been preserved. Upstream select_demand produced 8 rows, but normalize filtered with an allowed_record_ids list that contains n06-r09 instead of n06-r06, reducing needs_df to 7 rows. The downstream job received exact hash handoffs of those upstream artifacts and preserved the 7-row input, so the supported localization is upstream normalize.
cited_evidence: top_level_input.corpus contains record_id n06-r06 with demand_score 5, need 'compare selected and complete runtime evidence', source_id s06, source_weight 3.
job_upstream_demand_provenance select_demand uses demand_score >= 3 or fallback ids and its selected state has 8 rows.

job_upstream_demand_provenance retained_df/needs_df after normalize has 7 rows.
